data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'amare,' which means 'to love.' In Christian tradition, Amor is a symbol of divine love, particularly the love between God and humanity. The name Amor carries the meaning “Love” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amor usually hope their child will grow to embody love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes unconditional love and divine connection.
data.etymology: Amor belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amor total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
data.cultural_impact: Amor is not a common Christian name, but it carries a rich cultural significance. In Roman mythology, Amor was the god of love, and in Christian tradition, this name symbolizes the boundless love that God has for all of humanity. The cultural impact of this name is rooted in the powerful human emotion of love and the belief that love is the fundamental force that connects us all.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Amor is deeply rooted in the Christian faith's emphasis on love. The name reminding us of God's infinite love for all of His creation and the call to love our neighbors as ourselves. It also highlights the importance of selfless, agape love in the Christian life, which is a reflection of God's love for us. The name Amor serves as a powerful reminder of the transformative power of love and the role it plays in our relationship with God and with one another.
